songs.title: You Should, You Shouldn’t 😌
lines: You should take a deep, deep breath,
Take a breath, take a breath,
You should start your work early,
You shouldn't wait till the end,
Talk to your family and friends,
n: 곡조: London Bridge Is Falling Down (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
deep breath에서 함께 크게 숨쉬기, stress ball에서 주먹 꽉 쥐었다 펴기
songs.imgPrompt: Calm children taking deep breaths, listening to music, squeezing stress balls and talking with family.
